experiment: A single full-scale three-span continuous roof assembly of 9 1/2 in. Z-purlins (two purlin lines, 30 ft spans, 24 ga. through-fastened ribbed panels) was tested in a vacuum chamber under uplift pressure with 2x2x1/8 in. angle braces at the quarter points of the end-bay bottom (compression) flanges, and the measured failure load was compared with AISI-6 and MBMA Ad Hoc Task Force predictions.
title: MBMA Uplift Test #B-1: Discrete Point Braced Compression Flange, Continuous Span 9 1/2 in. Z-Purlin Uplift Test (April 4, 1988 Ceco Buildings Division Report)

variables.definition: Designation of the uplift test specimen assembly as printed (#B-1 braced test; #3 is the earlier unbraced reference test).
variables.evidence: Table 1 p.2; Table 2 p.3; Table S1 pp.2-3,9,11
variables.name: Test identification

variables.definition: Purlin cross-section shape as printed (Zee).
variables.name: Section type

variables.definition: Direction of the applied load on the assembly (uplift).
variables.name: Load direction

variables.definition: Nominal (Tables 1 and S1) and measured end (Table A) web depth of the Z-purlin.
variables.evidence: Table 1 p.2; Table A p.4; Table S1
variables.name: Purlin web depth
variables.note: Table A value is measured at one end; Tables 1 and S1 give the nominal 9.5 in.

variables.definition: Nominal flange width of the Z-purlin as printed in the test parameter table.
variables.name: Nominal flange width

variables.definition: Measured width of the top flange of each purlin at mid-span.
variables.name: Measured top flange width

variables.definition: Measured width of the bottom (punched) flange of each purlin at mid-span.
variables.name: Measured bottom flange width
variables.note: Bottom flange is the one with connection holes punched in it.

variables.definition: Measured length of the top flange stiffening lip at mid-span.
variables.name: Top lip length

variables.definition: Measured length of the bottom flange stiffening lip at mid-span.
variables.name: Bottom lip length

variables.definition: Measured angle between the top flange and its stiffening lip at mid-span.
variables.evidence: Table A p.4 (footnote: lip angles in degrees)
variables.name: Top lip angle

variables.definition: Measured angle between the bottom flange and its stiffening lip at mid-span.
variables.name: Bottom lip angle

variables.definition: Measured inside bend radius at the web-to-flange corners (top and bottom) of each purlin.
variables.name: Web-flange corner radius
variables.note: Reported separately for the top and bottom corners.

variables.definition: Measured inside bend radius at the flange-to-lip corners (top and bottom) of each purlin.
variables.name: Flange-lip corner radius
variables.note: Reported separately for the top and bottom corners.

variables.definition: Measured base metal thickness of the purlin (micrometer reading at one end in Table A; failed-member value in Tables 1 and S1).
variables.evidence: Table 1 p.2; Table A p.4; Table S1
variables.name: Purlin base metal thickness

variables.definition: Length of each individual continuous bay of the test assembly.
variables.name: Span length

variables.definition: Number of continuous spans in the test setup.
variables.name: Number of spans

variables.definition: Number of parallel purlin lines in the tested assembly.
variables.name: Number of purlin lines

variables.definition: Length of the purlin lap splice at the interior supports.
variables.name: Lap length at interior supports

variables.definition: Initial lateral sweep of the purlins measured before loading (zero because the discrete braces held them straight).
variables.name: Initial lateral sweep

variables.definition: Description of the roof sheeting and its attachment (24 ga. ribbed, through-fastened).
variables.name: Roof panel type

variables.definition: Description of the discrete compression-flange bracing provided (2 x 2 x 1/8 in. angle braces at quarter points of end-bay bottom flanges).
variables.name: Compression flange bracing

variables.definition: Uplift load per foot of purlin sustained at failure (printed as 134, 133.7 and 133.6 lb/ft in different places for the same 2.7 in. H2O failure pressure).
variables.evidence: Table 1 p.2; Table 2 p.3; Table S1 (pp.2-3, 9, 11)
variables.name: Failure uplift load per foot
variables.note: Three printed roundings of the same result; dead load of 8.5 lb/ft already deducted.

variables.definition: Observed failure mode and its location (web and compression-flange buckling of member B-3 at 10 ft 3 in. from the end support).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column failure_mode; Table E observations
variables.name: Failure mode and location

variables.definition: Measured yield strength of the failed purlin member used in the capacity evaluation, taken from the tension coupon averages.
variables.evidence: Table 1 p.2; Table 2 p.3; Table A p.4; Table S1
variables.name: Member yield strength
variables.note: Table A reports yield only for coupon-tested members A-3 and B-3.

variables.definition: Effective section modulus of the Z-purlin section used in the predicted-capacity calculations.
variables.name: Effective section modulus

variables.definition: Uplift failure load predicted by the AISI-6 (May 1986 draft AISI specification as modified in the MBMA Ad Hoc Task Force report) method.
variables.name: Predicted load, AISI-6 method

variables.definition: Measured failure load divided by the AISI-6 predicted load.
variables.name: Test-to-AISI-6 ratio

variables.definition: Uplift failure load predicted by the MBMA Ad Hoc Task Force proposal.
variables.name: Predicted load, MBMA method

variables.definition: Measured failure load divided by the MBMA Ad Hoc Task Force predicted load.
variables.name: Test-to-MBMA ratio
variables.note: Printed as 1.10 in the tables and 1.09 in the hand calculation note.

variables.definition: Purlin line (A or B) in the test frame from which a dimension specimen came.
variables.name: Purlin line

variables.definition: Bay or bays spanned by each purlin piece (e.g. 1/2 = spans 1 and 2).
variables.name: Spans covered by piece

variables.definition: Identification number of the individual purlin piece (A-1 ... B-3).
variables.name: Specimen number

variables.definition: Shop piece mark printed in parentheses with each specimen number.
variables.name: Piece mark

variables.definition: Purlin member (A-3 or B-3) from which each tension coupon was cut.
variables.name: Coupon source member

variables.definition: Coupon test number on the laboratory sheet, or AVER. for the averaged row.
variables.name: Coupon test number

variables.definition: Coupon geometry type per ASTM A370 (SHEET).
variables.name: Coupon type

variables.definition: Measured width of the tension coupon.
variables.name: Coupon width

variables.definition: Measured thickness of the tension coupon.
variables.name: Coupon thickness
variables.note: Distinct from the purlin thickness measured in Table A.

variables.definition: Cross-sectional area of the coupon, width times thickness.
variables.name: Coupon area

variables.definition: Load recorded at the yield point of the coupon in the tension test.
variables.name: Coupon yield-point load

variables.definition: Maximum (failure) load reached by the coupon in the tension test.
variables.name: Coupon maximum load

variables.definition: Yield-point stress of each coupon and the per-member average as printed.
variables.name: Coupon yield stress
variables.note: Printed coupon-3 values are inconsistent with load/area and were preserved verbatim.

variables.definition: Failure (ultimate tensile) stress of each coupon and the per-member average as printed.
variables.name: Coupon tensile strength

variables.definition: Original gauge length marked on the coupon (2 in. per ASTM A370).
variables.name: Original gauge length

variables.definition: Gauge length measured after fracture of the coupon.
variables.name: Final gauge length

variables.definition: Percent elongation of the coupon over the 2 in. gauge length, and the per-member average.
variables.name: Coupon elongation

variables.definition: Pressure-box manometer reading on one leg at each load step, indicating the applied chamber pressure.
variables.name: Manometer pressure reading

variables.definition: Total uplift load per foot of purlin at each load step, converted from the manometer reading with the dead load subtracted.
variables.name: Applied uplift load per step
variables.note: Negative value (-8.5 lb/ft) at zero manometer reading is the dead load.

variables.definition: Flag identifying whether a row of readings is a vertical deflection (Δ) or a bottom-flange horizontal movement (B).
variables.name: Reading type flag

variables.definition: Dial readings of vertical deflection or bottom-flange horizontal movement on purlins A-1, B-1 (north end bay) and A-3, B-3 (south end bay) at each load step.
variables.name: Purlin deflection/movement readings
variables.note: Readings at the failure step are blank with 'FAILURE' printed for B-3.

variables.definition: Horizontal (longitudinal) movement of the end support beams at lines 1 and 4 at each load step.
variables.evidence: Table E p.9; note in Table S1 (avg. 0.161 in.)
variables.name: End support horizontal movement
variables.note: Average movement 0.161 in. judged sufficient to relieve catenary forces.

variables.definition: Observer notes recorded at each load step describing specimen behavior.
variables.name: Test observations

variables.definition: Roof tributary width per purlin line (5.06 ft) used to convert chamber pressure into load per foot.
variables.evidence: Table S1 header note on load conversion (p.11 hand calculation)
variables.name: Tributary width per purlin line
variables.note: Stated in a note, not a column.

variables.definition: Self weight of the assembly (8.5 lb/ft) subtracted from the applied pressure load to get net uplift load.
variables.evidence: Table S1 FACTORS note; Table E note on -8.5 lb/ft at zero manometer
variables.name: Assembly dead load

variables.definition: Factor 10.4 converting a one-leg manometer reading in inches of water to chamber pressure in psf.
variables.evidence: Table S1 FACTORS note (p.11 hand calculation)
variables.name: Manometer-to-pressure factor
variables.note: Stated in a note, not a column.

variables.definition: Source location in the report from which the summarized failure value was taken (hand calculation) and the corresponding PDF pages.
variables.evidence: Table S1 columns value_source and pages
variables.name: Failure value source
variables.note: Provenance metadata rather than a physical quantity.
